name: Octree-based Isosurface Search with Taylor Expansion
definition: A method to compute isosurface intersection points within an octree structure by evaluating the scalar field u(r) using higher-order Taylor series expansions rather than linear interpolation, allowing for high-accuracy intersection detection via optimization.
summary: This method computes isosurface intersections within an adaptive octree by using higher-order Taylor series expansions instead of linear interpolation, enabling high-accuracy detection via optimization.
